name: sendAppointmentNotificationWebhook
shortDescription: Sends a webhook notification to external systems upon creation, update, or cancellation of an appointment.
description:
Overview

Sends a webhook notification to external systems when an appointment is created, updated, or cancelled. This ensures that integrated systems are kept informed of appointment status changes in real-time.

Intended use

This function is intended to be invoked as an event handler, typically triggered by a platform post-save hook on the Appointment entity. It receives the appointment details as parameters.

Logic

  1. Receive the Appointment record details from the triggering event.
  2. Construct a JSON payload containing relevant appointment information (ID, status, patient ID, doctor ID, dateTime).
  3. Send the payload to the configured WebhookService using ctx.service('WebhookService').send_notification.
  4. Audit-log the webhook dispatch with ctx.audit.log, including the appointment ID and webhook status.

Entities

  • Appointment

External Services

  • WebhookService
